hero.label: Wan 2.7 workspace
hero.title: Wan 2.7 Video Generator
hero.description: Create a text-led shot across five aspect ratios, or animate a first and optional last frame. The workspace supports 720p and 1080p with a focused five-, ten-, or fifteen-second control set.
hero.verdict: Choose Wan 2.7 when framing flexibility and prompt cleanup matter. Keep prompt enhancement on for rough briefs; turn it off when exact wording is part of the test.
hero.source_note: The page separates Wan 2.7 upstream ranges from the discrete controls exposed in this product. Verify the selected settings and credits before submission.

sections.title: Where Wan 2.7 fits best
paragraphs: Wan 2.7 is a practical choice for campaigns that need the same idea reframed across landscape, portrait, square and 4:3 families. Text-to-video exposes those ratios directly; image-to-video follows the supplied frame.
Its prompt extension can turn a compact brief into richer visual direction. For a controlled comparison, disable it so the submitted wording remains the independent variable.
bullets: Create landscape and portrait variants from the same shot plan.
Use a last frame when a product or character must land in a precise composition.
Put artifact risks such as flicker or unreadable text in the negative prompt.

sections.title: Use one subject, one change and one camera move

examples.label: Vertical social shot
examples.text: 9:16 portrait. A pastry chef places a mirror-glazed cake beneath a warm pass light. Slow handheld push in, subtle steam, stable hands and cake geometry, realistic kitchen reflections, no labels or on-screen text.

examples.label: First and last frame
examples.text: The fabric moves in a single clean wave from the opening arrangement to the final frame. Locked camera, soft side light, realistic material weight, no extra objects, no color shift, no flicker.

faqs.question: Is Wan 2.7 available for real generation here?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wan 2.7 is preselected in the generator above for both text and image workflows. You need an account with enough credits.

faqs.question: Which Wan 2.7 durations are exposed?
faqs.answer: The upstream API accepts 2–15 seconds. This product currently offers 5, 10 and 15 seconds to keep selection and credits predictable.

faqs.question: What does Enhance prompt do?
faqs.answer: It sends Wan's prompt_extend option. Keep it enabled for terse briefs; disable it when you need a controlled wording test.

faqs.question: Can Wan 2.7 generate audio here?
faqs.answer: This interface does not expose a generated-audio switch for Wan 2.7. The upstream text endpoint accepts an optional external audio URL, which is not part of the current product workflow.
